notes: Low-resource main configuration (user decision of 2026-10-02): configs/serl_agentclinic_qwen4b_max7.json on the environment v11 (dataset version agentclinic_main_v2_train30: TRAIN 30 / DEV 31 / TEST 60). Effectiveness predictor connected on 2026-10-02 after gRPC parity (outputs/effectiveness/v11_qwen4b_gemma12b_max7_train30/effectiveness_oof_v2: TRAIN-only selection and calibration, DEV evaluated once).

effectiveness.notes: Frozen max7 joint predictor; TRAIN-only selection/calibration; DEV evaluated once; actual gRPC parity passed.

selection.max_rubrics_notes: User decision of 2026-10-02, frozen before any rubric of this experiment was generated and before any Ours training: a per-iteration rubric budget of at most 8. After validation, consolidation and the effectiveness-gap filter, the rubrics with the largest gap are kept, at most 8; when fewer pass, all of them are used (never filled up to 8). Applies to every condition that uses the effectiveness-gap selection (Ours, Ours - Outcome, Ours - Effectiveness); Static keeps the R_0 of Ours (so at most 8); No-filtering has no filter and no budget. Chosen from no DEV or TEST result.

physical_gpus.policy: one GPU per run, set by CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES of the launch script (GPUs 2-5 on convei-rack7-27)

devices.physical_gpus_notes: The Effectiveness service is one process on physical GPU 1, shared by the runs (scripts/benchmark_effectiveness_service.py: 5 concurrent clients, no error, outputs equal to the offline predictor); every policy has a GPU of its own. The same declaration in every condition config.
